I answered Dana in the #north-team thread under her message: the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is for **261 seats**. Ilse Varga posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14.

Dana is a member of #north-team, so I only used what she can already see there. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it's fine to share with the North team. I also told her that the 185 seats from August 2025 was the earlier Amendment No. 1 count, not the renewal, so she doesn't put the wrong number in the tracker.
